report.summary: No hard-constraint breaches, rejected submissions or failure days. All five allocations seated every patient (zero overflow), so there are no bed displacement or fairness findings. The one substantive finding is a Moderate nurse_gap on day 8, a level 1 coverage shortfall that a different split of the same pool would have avoided. Bed assignment respected priority and fairness: overflow was only same-day L1 arrivals and no bed displacement or fairness inversion pair exists.
